1933-2226-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1933-2226-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Aether Adept by paying its mana cost.
When Aether Adept enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

574-4381-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
574-4381-4694-7306.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 1.
574-4381-4694-7306.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

2085-5107-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Kelpie Guide doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
2085-5107-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

513-3661-4336.easyPrerequisites: One of the creatures with mana cost {0} must be in your hand with the other being on the battlefield.
513-3661-4336.description:
Cast the creature with mana cost {0} from your hand by paying {0}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the other creature with mana cost {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Repeat.

985-5078-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

529-4186-4742-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2438-3197-6566--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Yuna triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 5.

2760-4279-7918.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2760-4279-7918.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature that will trigger Sifa Grent when it dies.
There is at least one additional creature on the battlefield.
2760-4279-7918.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any other creature and causing you to draw a card.
If the creature who had the counter placed has 0 toughness, it dies as a state-based action.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat until your opponents do not control any more creatures, or until you draw your library.
If you have cards remaining in your library, you may repeat this combo any time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-6254-6822.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Lyla triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton
Repeat.

215-527-1753.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-1753.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

240-4359-5256-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

141-3497-7301.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
141-3497-7301.description:
Cast Avatar's Wrath by paying its mana cost, targeting Ezzaroot Channeler
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Ezzaroot Channeler.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Avatar's Wrath targeting Ezzaroot Channeler
Resolve Avatar's Wrath, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat from step 3.

444-2894-3674-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
444-2894-3674-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Necroplasm. Then, the draw will be replaced by Necroplasm's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Necroplasm from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Drogskol Reaver triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

5686-6754-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3585-4050-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4875-5147-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
4875-5147-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

1651-4482-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-4482-6754-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-4482-6754-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Ancient Greenwarden, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

413-1734-6132.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

3054-3416-5670-6097.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
3054-3416-5670-6097.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2060-2350-4518-6930.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2292-5571-6922--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
2292-5571-6922--6.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Blightbeetle and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2921-4186-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
2921-4186-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1409-6586.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of static effects that increase Vivi's power by at least 2.
1409-6586.description:
Activate Vivi by paying {0}, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Vivi by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Vivi enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Vivi.
Repeat.

150-539-2098.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
150-539-2098.description:
Play Vesuva, and choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Titania.
Put Vesuva into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuva's first ability and second ability trigger, as well as Titania's second ability.
Resolve the second Vesuva trigger and the Titania trigger, creating two 5/3 Elemental creature tokens.
Resolve the first Vesuva trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Titania.
Repeat from step 2.

488-1482-2895-3200-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Jeweled Lotus or Urza's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-1482-2895-3200-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

413-643-3951-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
413-643-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

4559-4740-4772-5670.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 10.
4559-4740-4772-5670.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Treasures, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinitely to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1692-1965-3375.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a colorless creature you control.
1692-1965-3375.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Omarthis with haste.
Put a +1/+1 counter on the Omarthis token or another colorless creature you control.
The nontoken Omarthis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
The Omarthis token triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 3.

880-2653-4677.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Nissa and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2214-3259-4373.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and that has a power of one or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2214-3259-4373.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating a X/X Dinosaur creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Dinosaur token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1479-3875-5233.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3875-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Tireless Provisioner, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3630-3921-5007.notablePrerequisites: Morselhorder has at least one -1/-1 counter on it.
3630-3921-5007.description:
Activate Morselhorder by removing all -1/-1 counters from it, adding {B} for each counter removed.
Activate Wandering Mage's third ability by paying {B} and putting two -1/-1 counters on Morselhorder, preventing the next two damage dealt to you this turn.
Repeat.

341-1913-3685-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding {C}{C}.
Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Necron Warriors, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {6}.
Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, destroying a permanent.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each of your turns.

1295-3189.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least three devotion to blue.
1295-3189.description:
Cast Doomsday by paying {B}{B}{B}, searching your library and graveyard for any five other cards, exiling all other cards from your graveyard and library, and then placing the remaining cards on top of your library and losing half your life, rounded up.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, winning the game.

3633-4112.manaNeeded: {4}{W}{U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax
3633-4112.notablePrerequisites:
"Sphinx" chosen with Mirror of the Forebears.
Sharuum is your commander.
3633-4112.description:
Activate Mirror of the Forebears by paying {1}, making it a copy of Sharuum.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule, returning to the command zone.
Cast Sharuum from the command zone by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax.
Sharuum dies due to the legend rule.
 Sharuum enters the battlefield triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

11-2492-4821.notablePrerequisites: You control nonland permanents that can produce at least {1}{U}{U}.
11-2492-4821.description:
Cast Bonus Round by paying {1}{R}{R} and let it resolve.
Activate nonland permanents by tapping them to add at least {1}{U}{U}.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Bonus Round triggers, copying Dramatic Resolve.
Let the copy of Dramatic Reversal resolve, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}.
Bonus Round triggers, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal and choose the original Narset's Reversal as its target.
Let the copy resolve, copying Narset's Reversal and returning it to your hand, and choosing Dramatic Reversal as its target.
Let the remaining Narset's Reversal copy resolve, copying Dramatic Reversal and returning it to your hand.
Activate nonland permanents by tapping them to add at least {1}{U}{U}.
Let the Dramatic Reversal copy resolve, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.

651-4046-4479.description:
Pay {0} to activate Outrider en-Kor, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 untill end of turn.
Repeat steps 1-2 untill Task Force has infinite toughness.
Sacrifice Task Force to Life Chisel, gaining life equal to its toughness.
